verdict.rationale: Sift's documented Score API returns a synchronous 0–100 ML risk score per event via REST, with the Events API for real-time submission and a live runtime probe confirming the endpoint is active and responding per documented error vocabulary. Workflows/Decisions docs further show real-time decisioning tied to these scores. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sub-second/synchronous latency guarantees before authorization completes, and independent (non-vendor) benchmarking of real-time performance.
